architectures.name: GB200 NVL72
architectures.positioning: frontier — liquid-cooled rack-scale, 36 GB200 Grace-Blackwell superchips = 72 Blackwell GPUs + 36 Grace CPUs in 1 rack

provenance.source: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 product page — 36 GB200 superchips per rack, each combining 1 Grace CPU and 2 Blackwell B200 GPUs via NVLink-C2C; rack-scale NVLink 5 domain.
provenance.notes: Default GPU is the GB200 superchip (the deployable unit at the rack), NOT a standalone B200 baseboard. Per-GPU figures inherit from the underlying B200 (192 GB HBM3e, 8 TB/s, 9 PFLOPS FP4 dense per GPU); per-superchip aggregate is 2x that across its 2 Blackwell GPUs. OEM/ISV choices are illustrative for swap testing.

architectures.name: HGX (8-GPU baseboard)
architectures.positioning: workhorse — air or liquid, 8-GPU HGX B200/B300 baseboards in OEM servers; widely deployed for train + inference

provenance.source: NVIDIA HGX product page — HGX B200 8-GPU and HGX B300 8-GPU baseboards.
